preregistration: preregistration.json (GitHub 1914106, before generation, world and capture)
deviations: Only 3 of 8 preregistered topics gave >= 16 parsed C3 sentences (airports, swimming pools, post offices); the preregistered reserve rule was applied, so the text test has 72 instead of 120 episodes.

Text train/calibration/retention rows are the plan-v2 episodes of rounds 3/4 and their recaptured taps are identical in value; only the text test partition is new. The tool world is entirely new (values never used in round 5).
finding: Tool world CONFIRMED on fresh data: 24/24 runs pass, learned residual 5-45 percent of mean-delta test MSE per action (median overall ratio 0.206). Text actions NOT_CONFIRMED: 11/30 pass (all 6 l_out-11 last-token runs, 3/6 l_out-23 last full, 2/6 l_out-11 mean, 0 for mean-pooled final and l_out-23 mean); failures are retention delta-0 and the .98 gate on negate/question. Within the preregistered scope: a fixed mean-delta base plus a ridge residual on frozen native taps predicts real tool action outcomes better than all controls; for text rewrites only on mid-layer last-token taps.
